name: Koi Sense Hai Is Baat Ki - Anubhav Singh Bassi
visual_description: Two-panel meme of comedian Anubhav Singh Bassi performing stand-up on stage. Top panel shows him asking 'Koi sense hai is baat ki?' and bottom panel shows him answering 'Humein bahut lag rahi thi us time'.
usage_context: Used to describe irrational, illogical, or bizarre decisions and actions that felt completely justified or made total sense in the heat of the moment.
keywords: koi sense hai is baat ki
humein bahut lag rahi thi us time

example.situation: Drinking 4 cups of coffee at 2 AM before an 8 AM exam

text_areas.description: The irrational decision or action that made sense back then
